pixel_review_observations: Full board and profile detail pixels inspected. Opposite profile views retain a long neck, short tail, cloven feet, brown/moss-olive seed-catching coat and blunt muzzle.
Three-quarter views show four legs. Foot close-up depicts two cloven keratin toes. Feeding is plant-based and no predatory fangs or mechanical parts are visible.
Dorsal/ventral and behavior panels exist; high browsing, ducking, root step and managed root-arch grove are illustrated.
unresolved_qa: Neutral profile forelegs overlap heavily; not all hidden limbs receive LF/RF/LH/RH callouts, so full four-limb traceability is incomplete in those views.
Dorsal/ventral feet are foreshortened and partly obscured. Toe count cannot be validated in every small pose.
Broad grinding teeth are described but not clearly exposed; dental topology remains unresolved.
Leaflike tufts could be read as attached foliage rather than entirely fur with loose burrs; material separation needs art review.
Joint overlay, neck flexion and motion contacts are proposed visual intent, not a validated rig or anatomical construction.
